title: Autosens freezing / failing to update - 3.1.0.2
symptom: Autosens appears to freeze its update sporadically since updating from 3.0 to 3.1.0.2. The issue appears to resolve itself with next blood sugar update, but is happening sporadically. It was not occurring on 3.0.
fix: The issue is improved by caching last autosens value in dev already.
evidence_quote: improved by caching last autosens value in dev already
